issue_context.title: object of type 'NoneType' has no len() in homeassistant.components.lifx
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I recently started getting an error with one of my Lifx devices (an LIFX Z light strip):

```
Logger: homeassistant.components.lifx
Source: components/lifx/coordinator.py:214
Integration: LIFX ([documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lifx), [issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22integration%3A+lifx%22))
First occurred: 10:23:47 PM (77 occurrences)
Last logged: 11:37:03 PM

Unexpected error fetching Guest Window (XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX) data: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 258, in _async_refresh
    self.data = await self._async_update_data()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/lifx/coordinator.py", line 238, in _async_update_data
    methods.extend(self._async_build_color_zones_update_requests())
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/lifx/coordinator.py", line 214, in _async_build_color_zones_update_requests
    for zone in range(0, len(device.color_zones), 8)
TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()
```

I'm not 100% sure when this started occurring, but I belive it happend after updating to 2023.5.0 this afternoon. Perhaps a bug in how light strips are handled in the latest release? CC @bdraco and @Djelibeybi who I belive were working on this integration recently. Happy to provide additional debug info as needed.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.5.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

lifx

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lifx/

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

